title: Governance Event Registry
description: Persistent registry for governance events: Rule Violations, Exceptions, Waivers, and Escalations. Supports full lifecycle tracking from OPEN through CLOSED.

fields.sourceFile: The pack file, script, or report that triggered this event
fields.linkedRule: RULE N — the governance rule this event relates to

autoIngestion.description: Rule 2 violations auto-create VIOLATION events. Duplicate QID+Type events are deduplicated.

options.--resolve <id> <status>: Transition an event to a new status
options.--summary: Show aggregate counts by type, status, and severity

integrationPoints: Governance Guard Engine (Board A): auto-ingest of DL-008 violations
Governance Dashboard (Board E): displays open events by type/severity
Rule Enforcement Matrix (Board F): links events to specific rules
Executive Review (Board J): reports event volume trends
futureEnhancements: Audit trail — append-only log of all status transitions
Linked events — parent/child relationships for cascading defects
Age-based escalation — events OPEN > 30 days auto-escalate
Export to DEFECT_LIBRARY.md format for cross-referencing
